title: Graduate quantum mechanics
purpose: Apply symmetry, operator methods and scattering theory, while tracking the assumptions of quantum approximations.
primary_reading: MIT 8.321 Quantum Theory I (use the supplements described in Section 12 for topics beyond the primary source.)

blocks.deliverable: Derive evolution in two pictures and compare observables.
Construct rotation operators and calculate a matrix element.
Work a coupled spin example with exchange symmetry.
Relate amplitudes and cross sections with correct normalization.
Trace out a subsystem and compare mixed and pure states.
Submit an independently checked derivation and take a graduate QM exam.

project: Reproduce a scattering or angular momentum calculation and verify it with a small computational example.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major result aloud without notes.
